method: Full scoped control objects verified against immutable original and PLAN. Current/root/extension/effective qualifications read as governing rules; duplicate normalized mirrors were checked for exact object equality. Targeted source conditions/positive/reverse/regression review independently establishes scoped judgments. Author summary is corroboration, never the approval source.
limits: No entire unrelated history reread, recursive proof traversal, author-verifier execution or third-round global review. Source identities and declarations do not grant unstated semantic reading credit.
skills_check: AGENTS.md read at exact candidate; no .agents tree in candidate and /workspace/.agents contains no skills. No additional skill workflow used.
temporary_audit_scripts: Only newly written /tmp/b11-audit.py, /tmp/b11-audit-extension.py and inline Git/JSON/text/hash checks; no historical script loaded for execution.
